name: Asian Paints Ltd
title: Asian Paints Ltd - 500820 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volume +12.4% and FY26 decorative volume ~9% on price-led margin gains, but management guides high single-digit to 8-10% volume with ~11% price hikes against ~20% cost inflation and discounting unchanged.

triggers.label: Price hikes ~11% vs ~20% cost inflation
triggers.quote: We feel that the impact is much higher, maybe closer to about 20% or so. We have passed on around 11%.

triggers.label: Competitive intensity to keep rising
triggers.quote: the competitive intensity will continue to grow in terms of how we see the year ahead.
triggers.highlight: competitive intensity will continue to grow

triggers.label: March upstocking adds 3-4% to growth
triggers.quote: The impact of that would be for the month of March, the March growth rates would be higher by 3-4% mark

triggers.label: Margin guidance 18-20% held
triggers.quote: We are maintaining our margin guidance, which is there.
triggers.highlight: We are maintaining our margin guidance

triggers.label: Volume guided 8-10% FY27
triggers.quote: we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%
triggers.highlight: closer to high single-digit volume growth

guidance.quote: closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward
We are maintaining our margin guidance, which is there.

red_flags.label: Discounting intensity unchanged despite price hikes
red_flags.quote: we have not seen any let -up in terms of the discounting in the market.

red_flags.label: Margin guide held vs ~20% cost inflation
red_flags.quote: We feel that the impact is much higher, maybe closer to about 20% or so.

evasions.topic: Market share FY26 vs prior year
evasions.quote: All the results are out in the market, all of you can calculate the shares
it is too early to say because there are several factors at play
